notes:
Notes from AE/SE/Customer conversations. Shorthand, fragments.
- Customer: Veloce runs a SaaS CX product (chat-first).
- Primary ask: hosted API for speed to market; potential move to Dedicated after 6-12 months if committed throughput required.
- Latency: 95p token latency target ~<200ms end-to-end, streaming start <100ms. Will measure both cold and warm KV-cache scenarios.
- Streaming + tool calling: MUST support reliable function/tool calls (webhook retries, idempotency). Customer: 'If tool-calls drop or reorder, it's a no-go.'
- Security: SOC2 required; SSO via SAML mandatory; audit logging + retention controls; explicit PII redaction in logs (mask email, ssn, payment tokens). Cannot retain raw transcripts >30 days.
- Data residency: US-only for now (customer legal). KMS integration preferred for encryption at rest.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market, careful of per-token costs; prefers batching suggestions and quantization guidance.
- Procurement: needs 3 vendor refs, liability/DPAs reviewed by Feb legal team.
- Quote: asked for hosted tier with burst + fallback to Dedicated price model for 12-18 month horizon.
- Action items: AE to share SOC2 bundle and control matrix; SE to draft POC test plan; infra to share SAML metadata template.
- References: ff_2026_02_18_9ab3; thread-18493022; RD-11234.
